notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, every item in exactly one test, no spares. Per test 38 common (76%, the real 75 of 100) + 6 mercancías + 6 viajeros (the real exam has 25 of the candidate's own speciality). Training: five topic sets 22701-22705 (conducción racional y frenos 48, tiempos y tacógrafo 44, riesgos, salud y emergencias 60, mercancías 24, viajeros 24): 5 + 4 = 9 dashboard steps. passPct 67 = ceil(0.67 x 50) = 34 of 50, the real 50 net points with +1/-0,5 when every question is answered (66,7 of 100 right).
